pos.title: Speed up checkout. Stay in control.
pos.description: An interface designed for cashiers and managers: shorten queues and automate inventory updates in real time.
features: Receipts, DGI invoices, credit notes and deposits
Instant split payments: gourdes (HTG) and dollars (USD)
Immediate stock deductions and low-stock alerts
Automatic backups and sync when the network returns
